findings.question: Q4
findings.title: Interruption before native entry capture leaves a live mapping in the recovery buffer, allowing observed simulated spend to disappear on restoration and dispatch to repeat
findings.evidence_type: EXECUTED deterministic interruption checkpoints, independently corroborated by native recursion exhaustion without monkeypatching
smallest_reproduction: Build the existing synthetic battery desk with accounts() returning the live native o.ledgers/o.experiments dictionaries. Save a BudgetLedger.from_dict checkpoint before execution.
Dispatch the admitted simulated action once, settling run.1 into its solver ledger.

At the next pin, raise KeyboardInterrupt at the first two _retain_handing calls: initial entry capture and immediate recovery. Both exceptions are propagated/refused; the unfinished buffer nevertheless retains a plain tuple containing live dictionaries.
Restore o.ledgers[lid] to the pre-spend checkpoint using ordinary dictionary entry replacement.
Dispatch the same admitted action. Recovery now reads the restored live mapping as though it were the interrupted handing; dispatch succeeds and the executor counter reaches 2.

actual_result.native_corrobation: With recursion limit 150, deep(145, reader) and deep(146, reader) raise native RecursionError, leave pending_types=[tuple], and permit redispatch after restoration (executor_calls=2). No monkeypatching is used in this probe.

findings.expected_result: Once the execution side has handed the spent account, an interruption followed by detached restoration must not make the original action current again. Refuse redispatch while recovery cannot establish the retained original state; executor count remains 1.
findings.trust_boundary: Crosses the documented follower guarantee without malicious owner serialization or private mutation. The native corroboration uses ordinary stack exhaustion, canonical ledger checkpoint restoration, and native dictionary entry replacement.
findings.proposed_correction: Do not resolve an unfinished handing by rereading a live mapping as if it were the original handoff. Preserve original native entries before treating later recovery as sufficient; where entry capture itself is interrupted, retain explicit unresolved state that cannot authorize restored data, with a recovery design that avoids permanently declaring an honest reader corrupt. Add controls at _retain_handing itself, including native stack exhaustion and immediate recovery failure.
findings.limits: This is bookkeeping of simulated actions in existing synthetic fixtures, not a physical or external execution claim. Native depths 147-148 leave no retained handing and are not used as proof because failure may precede the handoff. Native depth depends on interpreter/call-stack shape; the deterministic checkpoint probe isolates the transition.

findings.question: Q4
findings.title: Two independent interrupted handings permanently retire an unchanged honest detached account because recovery compares identities before canonical reconciliation
findings.evidence_type: EXECUTED deterministic one-shot interruption at an explicit handing checkpoint
smallest_reproduction: Create the existing _simple fixture with a settled baseline ledger. Make accounts() return fresh BudgetLedger.from_dict copies of the identical unchanged payload on every call.
In each of two successive pins, inject one KeyboardInterrupt at _handed, allowing the immediate recovery call to complete normally.
After the first interrupted pin the account is only in _unread_entries. After the second it is in _diverged, even though both handings serialize identically.
Restore normal execution and read the same ledger. It is refused permanently as having rewritten its entries.

actual_result.later_honest_read: OwnerUnavailable: budget ledger a rewrote the entries of a state ... refused by this reader from then on

findings.expected_result: Interruptions of unchanged canonical detached checkpoints should refuse those invocations and allow an ordinary later pin to reconcile their equal canonical history. They must not permanently poison the account without evidence of a changed history.
findings.trust_boundary: No owner private mutation or dishonest serialization. Each handing is a canonical unchanged detached checkpoint; only deterministic asynchronous interruption points are injected.
findings.proposed_correction: Keep incompatible retained identity observations unresolved until existing canonical history can reconcile them outside the comparison lock, and apply the result only to the still-pending observations. Recovery must not turn distinct detached identities alone into irreversible divergence before that reconciliation can run.
findings.limits: Fail-closed availability/correctness defect, not demonstrated false admission. Each pin has only one interruption and recovery completes; this differs from the documented repeated KeyboardInterrupt in current account content residual.
